title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
hook_text: Mark Wahlberg backs AI acting clones.
script:
Mark Wahlberg is open to an AI clone continuing his acting career.
The actor says he will use AI to enhance his performances.
Wahlberg spoke about this on October 16 2026 at a tech event.
He views these tools as a way to extend his legacy.
Wahlberg is also investing in companies developing these new technologies.
Would you pay to watch a movie starring an AI clone?
